structure.unit: Planning, Subdivision of Land and Zoning

law.catch_line: Fee for processing application under § 15.2-2271 or § 15.2-2272
law.text: Any locality may prescribe and charge a reasonable fee not exceeding $150 for processing an application pursuant to § 15.2-2271 or § 15.2-2272 for the vacating of any plat.
